coupling: The earlier CPIX loader commit adds a consuming decode path for CDATA PlainValue text. At that point crypt_xml_get_text returns an allocated, trimmed copy, so decoding and freeing that text is correct; ordinary text takes the existing path. The later commit changes crypt_xml_get_text to return a borrowed pointer into the DOM text node, advancing past leading whitespace, and removes the old call-site frees. Its ordinary text callers remain read-only, but the CDATA consuming path added earlier still frees the borrowed interior pointer. The fix must reconcile the helper ownership contract with the CDATA consumer across both commits; changing only Base64 bounds or whitespace parsing does not address the invalid free.

pocs.entry_point: gf_crypt_info_load via public gpac/crypt_tools.h and gpac/tools.h
